message.content:
This is a used self-propelled excavator whose upper structure rotates 360 degrees, so it falls under heading 8429 (self-propelled bulldozers, graders, shovels, excavators and similar machinery). The 8429.52 subheading covers machinery with a 360° revolving superstructure. Under it, 8429.52.10 covers "Excavators" and the other items are under 8429.52.50 and 8429.52.90.

My recollection of the HTSUS structure is:
- 8429.52.10 — Mechanical shovels, excavators and shovel loaders with 360-degree revolving superstructure, with subdivisions:
  - 8429.52.10 — Track-type excavators? I believe 8429.52.10 is the statistical break "Excavators, track type" (8429.52.1010 and similar).
  - 8429.52.50 — Other.

CBP rulings on Yanmar mini excavators (a used Vio45 was in an antidumping/countervailing context) classified them under 8429.52.1010, which is "Self-propelled machinery: Track type, Excavators, other than hydraulic?" I am not certain of the suffix. The 8429.52.10 line is "Excavators: Track type" with the statistical suffix 8429.52.1010 for "Hydraulic?" I'll go with 8429.52.1010.

{"hts_code": "8429.52.1010", "reason": "A self-propelled track-mounted hydraulic excavator with a 360-degree revolving upper structure is classified in heading 8429, subheading 8429.52 (revolving superstructure machinery), as a track-type excavator."}
